lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

steps: Create point, line and polygon vector layers from the application
Add and edit one feature in each layer, restart the application and edit them again
Hide an editable layer, open object creation, select it and add a feature
Import a WGS84 GeoJSON without crs and one with urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::4326
On Android 16 import an EPSG:3857 GeoJSON and inspect the application log
Import a KML containing Point, LineString and Polygon coordinates
Import a GPX containing wpt, rtept and trkpt coordinates with name, time and elevation
Compare the resulting point count and order with both source files
Verify imported feature positions, add or edit a feature, restart and reopen the layers
Attempt to import malformed and coordinate-empty KML/GPX files
Attempt to import a file with an unsupported CRS such as EPSG:32637
value.expected: Manually created, local GeoJSON and flattened KML/GPX layers are editable before and after restart; a hidden editable layer remains offered for object creation and becomes persistently visible when selected; WGS84 data with no CRS or a common EPSG:4326 name imports at the correct position, each valid KML/GPX coordinate is a point in source order with available metadata, EPSG:3857 import does not attempt to change SQLite safety PRAGMAs inside a transaction, while an actually unsupported CRS and invalid or empty XML are rejected with a plain user-facing message and leave no incomplete layer.
